scope: Nine unique copy/name repairs and four exact table replacements. No design choices or invented example rolls.
authorization: Audit and proposal only. Not authorized for promotion. Each patch remains proposed.

patches.issue: Spot summaries omit the higher SPI option
patches.find: | **Spot** | 1 AP | Make an **INT Check** to reveal one eligible **Hidden** enemy combatant. |
patches.replace: | **Spot** | 1 AP | Make an **INT Check** or **SPI Check** against **12**, whichever is higher, to reveal one eligible **Hidden** enemy combatant. |

patches.issue: Spot summaries omit the higher SPI option
patches.find: **Spot:** A universal action. Choose one **Hidden** enemy within **12"** and **LOS**. **Spot** may choose a **Hidden** combatant despite the targeting restriction in **5.9**. Make an **INT Check** against **12**, with **Disadvantage** if that enemy has **Cover**. On success, that enemy loses **Hidden**. **Spot** does not remove **Invisible** unless a rule says otherwise.
patches.replace: **Spot:** A universal action. Choose one **Hidden** enemy within **12"** and **LOS**. **Spot** may choose a **Hidden** combatant despite the targeting restriction in **5.9**. Make an **INT Check** or **SPI Check** against **12**, whichever is higher, with **Disadvantage** if that enemy has **Cover**. On success, that enemy loses **Hidden**. **Spot** does not remove **Invisible** unless a rule says otherwise.

patches.issue: DEX Pen glossary says damage is unaffected
patches.find: **DEX Pen:** The **DEX** penalty listed by a piece of armour or a shield. It applies to **DEX Checks** and to any rule that uses the **DEX** modifier, and it does not reduce damage. See **7.10**.
patches.replace: **DEX Pen:** The **DEX** penalty listed by a piece of armour or a shield. It applies to the result of the wearer's **DEX Checks**, including **Dodge**, and to any damage total or other value that adds the wearer's **DEX**. See **7.10**.

patches.issue: Impassable Terrain summaries omit the Cover exception
patches.find: | **Impassable Terrain** | Cannot be entered, moved through, or ended in. Provides **Cover**. Does not block **LOS**. | **2.9.1** |
patches.replace: | **Impassable Terrain** | Cannot be entered, moved through, or ended in. Provides **Cover** unless its terrain entry says otherwise. Does not block **LOS**. | **2.9.1** |

patches.issue: Impassable Terrain summaries omit the Cover exception
patches.find: **Impassable Terrain:** Terrain that cannot be entered, moved through, or ended in. It provides **Cover**. It does not block **LOS**.
patches.replace: **Impassable Terrain:** Terrain that cannot be entered, moved through, or ended in. It provides **Cover** unless its terrain entry says otherwise. It does not block **LOS**.

patches.find: - Unless a scenario says otherwise, neutral Monster Groups treat other neutral Monster Groups as allies and every party combatant as an enemy. A Monster that is **hostile to all** treats every other combatant as an enemy.
patches.replace: - Unless a scenario says otherwise, neutral Monster Groups treat other neutral Monster Groups as allies and every party combatant as an enemy. A Monster that is **hostile to all** treats every other combatant, including Monsters from other Groups, as an enemy. Monsters in the same Group remain allied to one another unless a rule explicitly says otherwise.

patches.issue: C.13 AI flow continues after a valid AI Step
patches.find: 4. Evaluate numbered **AI Steps** in ascending order. For a step marked **on d6 N+**, roll **1d6** and require **N** or higher. Resolve the first valid step.
patches.replace: 4. Evaluate numbered **AI Steps** in ascending order. For a step marked **on d6 N+**, roll **1d6** and require **N** or higher. Resolve the first valid step. Resolving a valid step ends the activation unless that step explicitly says it continues. If no step is valid, proceed to step 5.

patches.issue: Two solo objective fields use names absent from their scenario objects
patches.find: **Solo/Co-op Objective:** Extract the Central Lens, at least 1 Lesser Fragment, and at least half the party through any battlefield edge as defined in **10.6.10**.
patches.replace: **Solo/Co-op Objective:** Extract the Star Lens, at least 1 Bronze Orrery Fragment, and at least half the party through any battlefield edge as defined in **10.6.10**.

patches.issue: Two solo objective fields use names absent from their scenario objects
patches.find: **Solo/Co-op Objective:** Move the Cartographer's Map off the battlefield through the edge opposite its starting edge, then extract at least half the party through that edge as defined in **10.6.10**.
patches.replace: **Solo/Co-op Objective:** Move the Survey Map off the battlefield through the edge opposite its starting edge, then extract at least half the party through that edge as defined in **10.6.10**.
